title: HarnessKit project profile
description: Schema for config/project-profiles/<name>.json -- the machine-local project-overlay layer, matched to a target repo by project_root prefix (scripts/_lib.js#detectProjectProfile) or by exact project_root prefix on the file being written (scripts/_lib.js#findProfileForFile). 'default.json' is the fallback profile used when cwd matches no other profile's project_root. This schema also describes the shape a proposed team-committed profile (<project_root>/.harnesskit/profile.json, design-only) would use, so both layers stay structurally compatible. additionalProperties is true: real profiles (e.g. config/project-profiles/example-app.json) carry project-specific *_source pointer fields (identity_source, rules_source, ...) and a free-form _purpose string that this schema deliberately does not enumerate.
